question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Colleague
solution:
The correct answer is **"Co-worker."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Colleague"** means a person with whom one works, especially in a profession or business. (सहकर्मी)

 
 
• **Example**: *He is my **colleague**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Co-worker"** is a person who works with another person towards a common goal. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के साथ एक सामान्य लक्ष्य की दिशा में काम करता है)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He is my **co-worker**__.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of **colleague** is **co-worker**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Consult)** means to seek information or advice from someone with expertise in a particular area. ((किसी के विषय में) किसी से जानकारी या सलाह माँगना अथवा पुस्‍तक आदि में जानकारी ढूँढ़ना)
 
• **Option 3 (Distend)** means to swell or expand by pressure from inside. (अंदरूनी दबाव के कारण फूलना या फुलाना, अफरना या अफराना)
 
• **Option 4 (Exempt) **means to free someone or something from an obligation or liability imposed on others. (आधिकारिक रूप से छूट देना)
